# Zaboraa — full plain-text reference

Zaboraa (https://zaboraa.com) is a founder-led enterprise VMware architecture advisory based in Pune. Tagline: Minimal Downtime VMware Cloud and Hyperscaler Migration Authority. It serves CIOs, infrastructure architects and migration leads at regulated, high-uptime organisations (banks, hospitals, logistics) moving VMware datacenters to Azure VMware Solution (AVS), Google Cloud VMware Engine (GCVE), VMware Cloud on AWS (VMC) or Nutanix NC2 on Azure.

Primary call to action: Book Briefing (free consultation). Secondary: use the free tools at https://zaboraa.com/tools. There is no pricing page, credits system or billing.

## Founder
Wasim Sayyed, Founder and Principal VMware Architect. Listed certifications: VCAP-DCV Design and Deploy; VMC on AWS Master Specialist; VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) Specialist; Azure Solutions Architect Expert; Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect; NSX-T Advanced Network Security. Stated track record: 13 years in VMware architecture, 40+ VMware migrations to AVS, VMC, GCVE, NC2, 100% zero-downtime cutover record.

## Advisory specialisations
- Hyperscaler procurement and sizing: avoid cluster over-provisioning by moving data to external NFS storage (Azure NetApp Files, Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP).
- HCX zero-downtime migration: production wave sequencing, Network Extension L2 stretching, Mobility Optimized Networking (MON).
- NSX-T microsegmentation: zero-trust Distributed Firewall rule discovery with Aria Operations for Networks before cutover.
- Disaster recovery validation: SRM non-disruptive failover testing, RTO sequencing, WAN delta modelling.

## Free tools (all run in the browser; RVTools, sizing and DR data does not leave the browser)
1. Multi-Cloud Node and Usable Storage Estimator — /tools/sizing. Covers NC2 on Azure (AN36, AN64, AN100), AVS (AV36P, AV36, AV48, AV52, AV64), VMC (i4i.metal, i3en.metal, m7i.metal-24xl), GCVE (ve1-standard-72, ve2-standard-128). Applies RAID/FTT policies and a default 25% vSAN slack factor. Shows host reduction from external NFS. Exports Excel.
2. RVTools Ingestion and Wave Planner — /tools/rvtools-analyzer. Parses vInfo, vDisk, vMemory, vNetwork, vTools. Detects physical-mode RDMs, multi-writer disks, hardware version below 14, missing or outdated VMware Tools, stale snapshots (older than 24h or over 20 GiB). Classifies each VM as HCX RAV, Bulk or Cold. Outputs readiness score 0-100%, wave schedule, Excel.
3. Nutanix NC2 on Azure Assessment — /tools/nutanix-nc2-assessment. AHV compatibility, VirtIO driver injection flags, NC2 sizing (AN36, AN36P, AN64, AN100) with RF2/RF3, Nutanix Move waves.
4. Aria Operations for Networks Engine — /tools/aria-networks. IPFIX flow discovery to application tiers, NSX DFW rule matrix, colour-coded wave spreadsheet.
5. DR RPO/RTO and WAN Planner — /tools/dr-planner. Compares VMware SRM with vSphere Replication, HPE Zerto, JetStream DR and Veeam Recovery Orchestrator. RPO from 15 minutes to 24 hours; hot standby, pilot light and cold storage models; Excel and 2-page PDF export.
6. Hybrid Blueprint Generator — /tools/design-generator. 5-step wizard (Objective, Source, Landing Zone, Security, Target and DR). Templates: VMware to AVS, VMware to NC2 on Azure, Nutanix to NC2 on Azure, VMware to GCVE, VMware to VMC on AWS. Outputs BOM Excel, 4K image, JSON, optional AI-rendered blueprint image (sign-in required by default).

## Case studies (client names anonymised)
- Tier-1 banking institution: core banking evacuation to AVS (Oracle RAC, SWIFT gateways). 1,240 VMs, 0 hours downtime, 38% TCO reduction, 90 days.
- Healthcare network of 18 hospitals: in-place NSX-V to NSX-T migration and zero-trust microsegmentation for 4,500 EHR and biomedical workloads. 0 minutes downtime, 24% capex reduction, 60 days.
- Global freight and supply chain: multi-AZ VMC on AWS stretched cluster handling 15M daily IoT events. 820 VMs, 99.999% availability, $1.4M per year saved, 45 days.

## Knowledge base topics (https://zaboraa.com/resources/kb)
AVS ExpressRoute FastPath BGP flapping and MTU fragmentation; mounting Azure NetApp Files NFS datastores on AVS; GCVE Private Services Access peering and DNS; VMC Connected VPC ENI routing asymmetry; migrating non-NSX workloads to NSX DFW; HCX MON asymmetric return traffic; SRM test-failover isolation; IPFIX on vSphere Distributed Switch for Aria.

## Tutorials (https://zaboraa.com/resources/tutorials)
AVS ExpressRoute FastPath and Global Reach; HCX Network Extension L2 troubleshooting runbook; NSX-T zero-trust east-west microsegmentation; external NFS datastores on VMC with Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP; GCVE to BigQuery analytics pipeline.

## Video masterclasses (https://zaboraa.com/resources/videos)
HCX Bulk vs Replication-Assisted vMotion; ANF datastores for AVS (cost and IOPS); NSX-T Distributed Firewall microsegmentation; GCVE Private Services Access and analytics.

## Migration roadmap (https://zaboraa.com/roadmap)
Six phases: RVTools discovery, HCX fleet provisioning, live L2 extension, wave migration, non-disruptive cutover, post-migration optimisation.
